nodes.label: BioShockVR 0.3.187-shadowownership
nodes.rationale: Recreates screen-space attenuation mask per eye at full private-eye dimensions to fix projected-light/gobo defects.

nodes.label: BioShockVR 0.3.186-bodysnap

nodes.label: AWrench

nodes.label: ShadowDepthTestPS

nodes.label: OpenXRInput Service
nodes.rationale: Dedicated, engine-neutral service implemented before weapon, HUD, or action routing to prevent duplicate action sets.

nodes.label: XInput Bridge
nodes.rationale: Routes movement and haptics through BioShock's existing controller ownership to preserve analog magnitude and engine semantics.

nodes.label: Render View Provenance
nodes.rationale: Groups eligible source draws by original HDR color-resource plus depth-resource identity to isolate main-camera from secondary views.

nodes.label: SOMAVR
nodes.rationale: Proven compositor pattern and lifecycle/binding pattern used as a reference for BioShockVR.

nodes.label: SS2VR

nodes.label: Build 0.3.9-hdrlanescout
nodes.rationale: Promote runtime build to a non-mutating HDR lane scout to identify repeated HDR scene lanes before any matrix/cbuffer mutation.

nodes.label: Build 0.3.10-layoutprobe
nodes.rationale: Add bounded cbuffer layout dumps to identify exact layout/offset identity in live 576/832/1088 buffers.

nodes.label: Build 0.3.11-drawlayout
nodes.rationale: Move layout dumps to the HDR draw site to join draw, stage, cbuffer pointer, and shader identity in one line.

nodes.label: Build 0.3.12-layoutwatch
nodes.rationale: Stratify draw-layout samples by OpenXR pose bucket to de-dupe by pose bucket plus stable draw identity.

nodes.label: Build 0.3.13-routeprofile
nodes.rationale: Profile repeated HDR routes to identify stable draw/shader/pass/target/depth/layout identities across HMD pose buckets.

nodes.label: Build 0.3.14-routedigest
nodes.rationale: Add ranked route digest to summarize stable routes rather than emitting raw first-repeat lines.

nodes.label: Build 0.3.15-routehits
nodes.rationale: Feed route digests from every live route hit to fix undercounting in the digest.

nodes.label: Build 0.3.16-routecensus
nodes.rationale: Add broad HDR route census to rank all HDR indexed route identities without dumping more cbuffer bytes.

nodes.label: Build 0.3.17-routescore
nodes.rationale: Score broad HDR routes to separate known foreground from unknown stable HDR route families.

nodes.label: Build 0.3.18-routecallsite

nodes.label: Build 0.3.19-writestack

nodes.label: Build 0.3.20-routefamily

nodes.label: Build 0.3.21-familydigest
nodes.rationale: Add whole-family digest to rank route families and expose unknown HDR candidates vs known foreground.

nodes.label: Build 0.3.22-familyprofile
nodes.rationale: Add focused cbuffer profiles to identify exact worldViewProj and reconstruction-constant offsets.

nodes.label: Build 0.3.23-offsetconfirm

nodes.label: Build 0.3.24-windowguard

nodes.label: Build 0.3.25-pairpreflight

nodes.label: Build 0.3.26-eyedeltaplan

nodes.label: Build 0.3.27-clonebind

nodes.label: Build 0.3.28-clonetrace

nodes.label: Build 0.3.30-temporalstereo

nodes.label: Build 0.3.31-poseproof

nodes.label: Build 0.3.34-sustainedwide

nodes.label: Build 0.3.35-directdraw

nodes.label: Build 0.3.38-sustainedproof

nodes.label: Build 0.3.41-eyeblitproof

nodes.label: Build 0.3.48-signflip

nodes.label: Build 0.3.49-splitsigns

nodes.label: Build 0.3.50-stablewide

nodes.label: Build 0.3.51-monoisolate

nodes.label: 0.3.53-blitcalibrate

nodes.label: 0.3.54-depthwindow

nodes.label: 0.3.55-linearizedepth
nodes.rationale: Linearize depth reprojection to view-space distance to improve mid/far object depth quality.

nodes.label: 0.3.56-depthdebug
nodes.rationale: Add exploratory depth debug views (linear_depth_gray, disparity_magnitude_gray) without changing the normal path.

nodes.label: 0.3.57-matrixstereoproof

nodes.label: 0.3.58-nativevs-pcenter
nodes.rationale: Correct native matrix proof to use P-center conjugated eye translation instead of flat post-projection shift.

nodes.label: 0.3.59-nativevs-isolate
nodes.rationale: Isolate native matrix rows from mono fallback contamination to identify geometry splits and occlusion holes.

nodes.label: 0.3.60-pcenterfitprobe

nodes.label: 0.3.61-screendatapcenter

nodes.label: 0.3.63-vscompanions
nodes.rationale: Add VS companion-constant proof (clip plane and local eye) to fix per-eye clipping and black side-facing surfaces.

nodes.label: 0.3.66-compact320
nodes.rationale: Track 320-byte compact-world VS constant buffers to fix flat props and items.

nodes.label: 0.3.67-shadowmaskab

nodes.label: 0.3.68-launchinject
nodes.rationale: Add launch-suspended injection to facilitate RenderDoc captures of the child process.

nodes.label: 0.3.69-eyedump
nodes.rationale: Dump post-blit OpenXR eye swapchain textures to BMP files to inspect live VR view without RenderDoc compositor capture.

nodes.label: 0.3.71-artifactprobe
nodes.rationale: Add hotkey-scoped draw/resource manifest to identify exact draws causing artifacts.

nodes.label: 0.3.72-srvfilter
nodes.rationale: Narrow screen-space SRV fallback by slot mask and index count to reduce architecture collateral.

nodes.label: 0.3.73-compact320gate
nodes.rationale: Relax compact 320-byte WVP preflight to allow affine gate to test sparse compact-world rows.

nodes.label: 0.3.74-compactscan

nodes.label: 0.3.75-artifactids
nodes.rationale: Enrich artifact rows with shader, cbuffer, and resource identity to group affected objects.

nodes.label: 0.3.76-psnulldepthskip
nodes.rationale: Skip private-eye replay for PS-null/depth-only HDR world draws to fix red/blue clear-color holes.

nodes.label: 0.3.78-psnullmonodepth
nodes.rationale: Fallback to mono depth for PS-null draws to maintain depth/color coherence.

nodes.label: 0.3.80-stereotoggle
nodes.rationale: Add Ctrl+F9 runtime toggle to compare native matrix stereo against mono private-HDR accumulation.

nodes.label: 0.3.81-priorarthints
nodes.rationale: Integrate 3D Vision ShaderFixes as log-only classifiers for artifact families.

nodes.label: 0.3.82-compactpsnullskip
nodes.rationale: Narrow compact PS-null private-replay skip for poster/frame clear-color class.

nodes.label: 0.3.83-fallbackdepthab
nodes.rationale: Test adventurous fallback-depth and clear-color A/B modes (black/neutral clears, depth-test/no-write).

nodes.label: 0.3.86-compactc10apply
nodes.rationale: Promote compact 320-byte c10-c13 WVP candidate behind fit-apply gate for props.

nodes.label: Decision: Synchronize Ctrl+F10 artifact and OpenXR BMP dump arms
nodes.rationale: A short keypress can be observed by the draw-stream poll but missed by the OpenXR blit-stage poll, producing useful log evidence without a matching BMP burst.

nodes.label: Decision: Disable compact PS-null private-depth skip
nodes.rationale: The compact c10 WVP candidate is now mapped and enabled, so the old compact skip may be blocking rows that can finally attempt matrix/private replay.

nodes.label: Decision: Pivot from compact skip to paired private depth/color evidence
nodes.rationale: Falsifies compact skipping as the visible root cause and points to paired depth/color identity, private depth, or mixed matrix/mono fallback interaction.

nodes.label: Decision: Test narrow mono-fallback color-pass depth conflict
nodes.rationale: Mono-fallback color/material passes with a real PS, depth testing enabled, depth writes disabled, and color writes enabled may be rejected by per-eye matrix depth in the private targets.

nodes.label: Decision: Test alternate WVP starts under the strict affine gate
nodes.rationale: A row that truly belongs in native matrix stereo should pass the same P_center affine gate when the correct WVP window is used.

nodes.label: Decision: Preserve 0.3.91 gains while increasing stereo readability
nodes.rationale: Raising StereoWorldWorldScaleMilli is a direct and reversible way to make Ctrl+F9 comparisons less ambiguous.

nodes.label: Decision: Prefer same-window attribution summaries over post-window F11 solo
nodes.rationale: The attribution entries collected during the Ctrl+F10 window are the authoritative evidence because the camera/object/material state is still the one the user aimed at.

nodes.label: Decision: Add family-specific screen-space SRV fallback selectors
nodes.rationale: The old broad screen-space fallback regressed architecture, so the next behavior change must be family-scoped and reversible.

nodes.label: Decision: Revert indexed-primitive family fallback
nodes.rationale: The visual result was negative: boulder/chest shader response regressed, both poster frames showed more red/blue private clear fallback.

nodes.label: Decision: Add shader/resource attribution packets
nodes.rationale: Cbuffer-size and route-family identities are too broad for individual shader issues. The next selector should be keyed by shader/resource identity.

nodes.label: Decision: Add exact-index screen-space SRV fallback selectors
nodes.rationale: Exact index-count plus slot-mask is a narrower and currently more reliable selector than either family or shader hash.

nodes.label: Decision: Add BSP-only exact screen-space SRV fallback selectors
nodes.rationale: Low index counts are too common for the global exact list, so the selector must require the BSP route family too.

nodes.label: Decision: Pivot full-eye presentation to OpenXR-sized native eye targets
nodes.rationale: More crop/blit calibration cannot become full-frame VR because the private eye producer is still rendering at the game HDR extent.

nodes.label: Decision: Treat UnrealPort as an offline RE reference
nodes.rationale: The repository is dominated by T3D map exports and conversion batches. It contains no D3D, OpenXR, stereo-view, or camera-hook implementation.

nodes.label: Decision: Probe native UpdateFocus independently
nodes.rationale: AShockPlayerController::UpdateFocus is the highest-value independent B4.5/B4.6 ownership seam.

nodes.label: Decision: Calibrate the proven rigid foreground group before native AimIK
nodes.rationale: Relative controller rotation and rigid wrench/arm attachment are already confirmed; the remaining visible mismatch is a large static authored-origin offset and excessive scale.

nodes.label: Decision: Drive native AimIK from a stable inferred torso frame
nodes.rationale: BioShock's native three-joint chain and solver are already mapped, so a custom vertex or iterative solver would duplicate engine functionality and fight authored animation.
